players.product: Falcon platform AI: Charlotte AI detection triage and SafeMind agentic security, run on rented AI compute (Cerebras inference, CoreWeave GPUs, NVIDIA NIM)

quarterly_data.signal: President Michael Sentonas: CrowdStrike's AI gateway (every AI request through one path; the customer decides which models its people can use and what may go out) 'will be shipping in September', first as a hosted SaaS version with a hybrid version shortly after, and Falcon Guardian customers get it; the Falcon Guardian capability shipped in the sensor some weeks ago and is an entitlement Falcon Flex customers can be running by the end of the day; CrowdStrike announced its Agentic Identity Provider (continuous identity discovery, enrichment and zero standing access for humans and agents), with more to come at Fal.Con Europe in November; its software supply chain protection policies, built into the platform, are already used by over 8,000 customers.
quarterly_data.figure: AI gateway shipping in September; over 8,000 customers using supply chain protection

quarterly_data.signal: SVP Counter Adversary Operations Adam Meyers: with the right harness CrowdStrike cut the 80% false positive rate it saw when using the Mythos model to find vulnerabilities down to 20%, and by June had submitted 2,400 vulnerabilities as CVEs (30% of all vulnerabilities reported in June) through responsible disclosure; for the first time agents were responsible for 2 and a half times more detections than humans across the platform. He announced Falcon Adversary OverWatch Cross-Domain Threat Hunting (available now, extending OverWatch to Guardian / AIDR, identity, cloud control plane and Next-Gen SIEM under one SKU) and Agentic Recon for dark-web credential exposure, due out in a few weeks.
quarterly_data.figure: 2,400 vulnerabilities submitted as CVEs; false positive rate cut from 80% to 20%
